notes: Scene names are prefixed MM PORTRAIT |. This toolkit renders the 1080x1920 portrait canvas only.

Source rects: 'media'/'media2'/'media3' use the template's capture slots between the backdrop and graphics layers. '-fill' cover-crops and '-stretch' distorts to fill. 'background' is fullscreen behind transparent graphics, 'a4' fits a slide, and [x,y,w,h] specifies a box in canvas pixels.
Fit modes: default is SCALE_INNER — any source aspect is letterboxed/pillarboxed inside its portrait rect. Use -fill to cover-crop or -stretch to distort.

Portrait safe area (TikTok): all template content stays above ~y1560 and left of x960; only the disclosure sits in the risky bottom band. Keep operator-placed sources inside the same zone with explicit rects if needed.

kind:camera sources become v4l2 capture devices (OBS Camera / DroidCam phones as UVC webcams). Two 'camera' entries fill CAM 1 then CAM 2 — give the second rect 'media2'. If no webcam is found at provision time a labeled browser placeholder is created instead; retarget it in OBS.
kind:game is any fullscreen capture (gameplay recording, console capture) placed behind the transparent overlay.

kind:ndi is a wireless phone camera via NDI|HX Camera (needs the obs-ndi plugin + NDI Runtime). Set "name" to the phone's NDI source name — leave it out and provisioning auto-picks when exactly one source is broadcasting.
kind:vdo is a wireless phone camera via VDO.Ninja — zero install. Put the OBS URL that vdo.ninja gives you into "url" (or retarget the source in OBS Properties → URL).
Sources marked TODO are placeholders — retarget them to real captures. Re-running provisioning never overwrites a URL you already changed.
The OBS canvas must be 1080x1920 portrait. There is no orientation select; every scene targets TikTok LIVE portrait.
OBS browser sources allow loopback URLs, so http://127.0.0.1:4320 works directly in OBS Studio.
